Tokyo

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
CountryJapan
Population14,094,034
Area2,194 km2

Tokyo, officially the Tokyo Metropolis, is the capital of Japan and one of the most populous cities in the world, with a population of over 14 million residents as of 2023.[1]

The city was formerly named Edo and served as the seat of the Tokugawa shogunate from 1603.

  • 1 History
  • 2 Geography

History[edit]

Tokyo was originally a small fishing village named Edo, in what was formerly part of the old Musashi Province.

  • 1457: Edo Castle is built.
  • 1868: The city is renamed Tokyo.
